_comment: What a one-shot Shift tap makes of the next character. A character listed in results is replaced by its result; the magic key, whose character the user chooses, gives magic_key_result, before any result its character has; any other character is typed in title case (é gives É, 1 stays 1). Both the Windows driver (TapHoldOneShotResult in platform/remap/tap_hold_loader.ahk) and the Linux one (platform/remap/tap_hold_manager.lua) read this file.
